en: Two black‑and‑white postcard photographs mounted on a decorative album page with clover motifs. The upper postcard shows a cycle-racing track event with cyclists lined up with pacer motorbikes in front of a grandstand crowded with spectators. Advertising banners in German are visible along the track. The caption at the bottom reads in German about a prize of the city of Leipzig. The lower postcard is a promotional/commemorative card printed in German, featuring an illustration of a steep wooden ramp and bridge-like structure used for a bicycle stunt, a small portrait of a man, and handwritten script over much of the card. The printed caption at the bottom names master rider Alfred Schneider and his 'phenomenal death jump'.
